correctness.rationale: Exact 81-entry symbolic expansion gives Phi(s,q); reflection makes symmetric laws sufficient. Feasible Jensen constraint q>=s^2 and Phi_q>=0 force q=s^2. The strict-increasing cubic g(s) has exactly one zero in (0,1), and balanced two-time sampling attains it. Strict matrix norm convexity and support at +/-sqrt(r) establish uniqueness of the cosine pushforward law. The included verifier independently checks the source adjacency and matrix exponential.

value.rationale: A 2023 source explicitly cautions that time-randomized uniform factor mixing need not tensorize under a synchronized observation clock. This gives the exact achievable compromise on its smallest documented non-instantaneously-uniform factor example, determines the unique optimal cosine law, and proves its strictly positive uniformity deficit is smaller than the deficit constrained by factor-uniform mixing. The precise nine-vertex target and Frobenius metric arise naturally from the original graph-product problem rather than arbitrary parameter slicing.
